MULTI-LEVEL ORDER VIEW (agreed need): cannot inspect the same order through corporate / kitchen / rider / Middo lenses — see O-ORDER-LENS

order_multi_level_view.problem: Ops/admin (and each actor) need to see one order from different levels: what corporate sees, what kitchen sees, what rider sees, plus Middo money/ops truth.

today.admin_ops: Shared OrderShow — staff 360 with links out to corporate/kitchen/rider *profiles*, not their order experience
today.corporate: List/cards + API track/support — no shared OrderShow; limited status narrative via CorporateApiPresenter
today.kitchen: ActiveOrders / group tables + dispatch modal — no dedicated order detail page
today.delivery: KitchenDispatches / DeliveredOrders / PaymentModal — action lists, no dedicated order detail page

desired.summary: One order, multiple lenses. From ops/admin OrderShow (or equivalent), switch perspective without leaving the order. Ops may intervene (mutate) at any operational level — not preview-only.

ops_intervention.rule: Ops (and admin) can intervene at any operation level: corporate-facing, kitchen-facing, rider-facing, and Middo money actions — subject to audit log + existing money invariants.
ops_intervention.implication: Lens UI is not read-only for ops; actions available on that lens are role-gated to admin|operation when opened as preview, and to the native role when opened as self-service.

lenses.shows: Full truth: parties, group, status/payment, money tree, payables, logs, box custody, complaints, force tools
Buyer-facing: menu/qty/when/where, payment, track timeline, support thread, cancel/edit eligibility — hide Middo P&L / partner shares
Cook/dispatch-facing: group mates, accept/ready/pack/dispatch state, deadline, boxes assigned, kitchen share/cash context — hide corporate wallet internals
Run-facing: pickup→drop, COD collection / Due / commission, empty-box return, handover state — hide kitchen capacity / Middo rest

design_notes: Prefer one Order resource + lens tabs/query (?lens=corporate|kitchen|rider|middo) over four divergent pages that drift
Native role pages should reuse the same lens components so ops intervene matches reality
AuthZ: ops/admin can open any lens and act; corporate/kitchen/rider only their own + scoped to their order
Deep-link from lists, alerts, complaints, money events into OrderShow with the right default lens
Overlaps O-ORDER force tools and parked rider who-holds-what — lens view is context; mutations stay audited
open_questions: RESOLVED: ops can intervene at any level (not preview-only)
Include package-subscription / custom-run contexts as additional lenses later?
Corporate web vs mobile API — same presenter contract for lens parity?

middo_money_account_model.question: When we debit/credit Middo, which account? Is there an unmovable Middo user account?
middo_money_account_model.answer: No Middo user/row in users. Middo cash is a singleton append-only ledger table, not a User.balance.

buckets_today.name: middo_cash_ledger
buckets_today.what: Physical/ops cash till Middo holds (COD Due accepted to Middo, kitchen transfers in; kitchen/rider withdrawals and Hub settles out)
buckets_today.api: App\Support\MiddoCashLedger::credit/debit — balance = latest balance_after; cannot go negative
buckets_today.not: Not a users.id; created_by is the human actor only

buckets_today.name: orders.middo_rest_amount + order_money_events (middo_rest)
buckets_today.what: Per-order P&L attribution (revenue minus kitchen/rider/other shares) — accounting truth on the order, not a cash movement

buckets_today.name: middo_operating_costs
buckets_today.what: Non-order costs (box/custom rider commissions) booked for P&L; credits rider_account_ledger but does not move MiddoCashLedger until withdrawal

buckets_today.name: partner wallets
buckets_today.what: Kitchen: KitchenAccountLedger (+ users.balance cache). Rider: RiderAccountLedger (wallet) + users.balance (Due float). Corporate: WalletLedger + users.balance

middo_money_account_model.gap: There is no unmovable/system Middo User account. That is fine for a ledger-centric design, but language in docs/UI saying 'credit Middo' means MiddoCashLedger (cash) or middo_rest (P&L) — easy to confuse. Optional future: a locked system party row for double-entry presentation, still backed by the same ledgers.
middo_money_account_model.recommendation: Keep MiddoCashLedger as SoT for cash; do NOT invent a loginable Middo user. If double-entry clarity is needed later, add a non-login system party / chart-of-accounts code, not a role=middo user.

accounts_role_proposal.question: Introduce user role 'accounts' to manage all accounting?
accounts_role_proposal.recommendation: Not yet as a full role — prefer permission scopes / Accounts Hub ownership first. Revisit when money surface grows (bank ledger, P&L, adjustments, dual-control).
why_not_now: Money tools already shared admin|operation (AccountsHub, Middo cash, kitchen/rider money) — ops already does day cash; splitting role without splitting duties creates empty seats
Day ops (handover accept, approve withdrawal) often needs the same person who is firefighting orders — a pure accounts role can bottleneck
No chart-of-accounts / period close / bank ledger yet — an accounts role would mostly inherit today's thin pages
when_it_helps: Dual control: ops accepts handovers / runs dispatch; accounts settles payables, cash adjustments, period P&L, bank recon
Segregation of duties for finance audit (ops cannot adjust Middo cash alone)
Dedicated nav: Accounts Hub, Middo cash, operating costs, COD recon, kitchen/rider money — strip those from day-ops sidebar
accounts_role_proposal.lighter_alternative: Add permission flags (e.g. manage-middo-cash, settle-payables, approve-partner-money, cash-adjust) grantable to operation and/or a future accounts role — same Livewire, different gates. Introduce role=accounts only when a real finance person exists.
